name: Need for a Cure
summary: Stranded along the rugged cliffs of northwestern Durotar, the Darkspear troll Rhinag lies poisoned by a venomtail scorpid. With precious little time before the toxin finishes him, he relies on a courier to sprint to Orgrimmar and retrieve a cure from Kor'ghan.

sections.title: A Scorpid's Sting
sections.body: The arid canyons of Durotar are crawling with venomtail scorpids, aggressive predators whose sting carries a swift, debilitating neurotoxin. Rhinag made the mistake of dropping his guard while battling the beasts near the borderlands. Knowing that the venom coursing through his veins will kill him in under an hour, he is unable to walk the distance to the city gates himself and must place his survival in the hands of whoever passes his remote camp.

sections.title: Secrets in the Shadows
sections.body: Rather than trusting an ordinary apothecary or shaman, Rhinag directs travelers deep beneath Orgrimmar into the shadowy subterranean caverns of the Cleft of Shadow. There dwells Kor'ghan, an enigmatic practitioner familiar with the harsh poisons of Durotar's wastes. Kor'ghan possesses the knowledge required to brew an effective counter-agent, though he rarely gives his aid freely to those who have not proven their mettle.

faq.answer: Rhinag is a Darkspear troll adventurer found clinging to life along the northwestern cliffs of Durotar. Stung by a venomtail scorpid, he fears both imminent death and the mockery he would face from his kin in Sen'jin Village if he were to return in such a humbled state.

faq.q: Why is Kor'ghan in the Cleft of Shadow?
faq.answer: Kor'ghan makes his home in the Cleft of Shadow, the shadowy cavern beneath Orgrimmar where warlocks, rogues, and other practitioners of dark arts ply their trades away from the eyes of Thrall's honored warriors. His understanding of venomous brews and grueling trials fits the Cleft's subterranean environment.

faq.q: Why doesn't Rhinag just seek a shaman or healer in Sen'jin Village?
faq.answer: Rhinag admits that his own pride holds him back. He fears that returning to Sen'jin Village in such a careless, venom-stricken condition would earn him nothing but mockery from fellow trolls, preferring instead to seek a discreet remedy from Kor'ghan.

faq.q: What happens after Rhinag receives the antidote?
faq.answer: Rhinag drinks the antidote and recovers, though his troubles do not end there. Knowing Kor'ghan, the curer will demand that Rhinag prove himself through further grueling trials—slaying boars and harvesting scorpid tails—before he is fully back in the practitioner's good graces.
He is located in the rugged bluffs of northwestern Durotar, nestled near the border passes leading westward toward the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is there such an urgent rush for this cure?
faq.answer: The venomtail scorpid's poison is exceptionally potent, giving an untreated victim less than an hour before the venom overwhelms their vital organs.

angles.text: Rhinag's dread of returning to Sen'jin Village underscores the harsh pride of the Darkspear tribe, where carelessness in basic wilderness survival invites harsh mockery from kin.
Durotar's rocky terrain is harsh and unforgiving, serving as an unrelenting trial by fire for newly arrived defenders of Thrall's young realm.
